status: reviewable diagnostic contract; legacy loader unchanged
asset_mapping: sorted exact paired filename stems; identifiers treated as strings, no company inference

comparison.scope: exhaustive all 27 pairs, all 688352 rows, all 45 columns
comparison.excel_clock_serialization: datetime.time -> HH:MM:SS, timedelta -> Python duration string; no modulo-24h conversion, no reclassification as grid observations
comparison.identifier_serialization: Workbook numeric identifier/date cells use exact integer strings; source CSV identifier text preserved. No zero-padding or issuer-name mapping inferred.

three_provenance_layers.supplied_file_values: presence/validity verified against paired workbook and cache values
three_provenance_layers.our_transformations: explicit reindexing, per-asset/day forward fill then zero fill; quote source time and method saved
three_provenance_layers.provider_process: unknown aggregation, provider filling, observation time, release time, units and adjustment policy

units: Original file numeric scale preserved; no provider unit certification or corporate-action adjustment established.
alignment: exact clock string after whitespace stripping; off-grid rows never seed fills; duplicate on-grid keys rejected by diagnostic
filling: per asset and date, forward fill each column using earlier on-grid values; remaining gaps zero fill; no backward fill, interpolation, or cross-day history

labels.formula: ask/bid arrays float32 before mid=(ask1+bid1)/2.0; float32 r=(mid_next-mid)/mid when mid>0
labels.threshold_comparison: original NumPy float32 scalar versus Python float epsilon; strict inequalities

class_order.1: Flat otherwise, including equality and nonpositive current mid

labels.horizon: next fixed-grid row, verified same-day exactly ten minutes
labels.rounding: No explicit rounding; original float32 arithmetic retained. Not sign-only labels.

features.implementation: log mid; log ask1/mid and bid1/mid; log1p ask/bid quantities levels 1–5, epsilon1e-9, final torch.nan_to_num
features.audit_scope: Top-quote labels/provenance reconstructed without importing torch or building training tensors.

populations.P0_legacy: All 27 assets x 493 common dates x 38 origins.
populations.P1_valid_cache_endpoints: Both endpoints originally present, finite positive bid1/ask1, no crossed quotes; same-date exact ten-minute target. Positive locks retained.
populations.P2_candidate_clock: Only origin>=09:10 and endpoint<=14:40 and same-date exact +10min: 33 origins 09:10–14:30.

evaluation_selection_warning: P1/P3 use future endpoint quality and are ex-post evaluation populations, not executable origin-time selection rules.
peer_availability_rule: Origin only; peer_origin_available_cache = origin_valid_original_cache_quote. Do not pass future-endpoint or P1/P3 eligibility into peer inputs.
upstream_observation_warning: Nonmissing workbook cell does not prove observed exchange quote; equal values do not prove imputation.

asset_id.description: String equal to input filename stem, including _t; no issuer-name inference.

date.description: Common date serialized YYYY-MM-DD; Asia/Seoul local-clock convention.

origin_time.description: Forecast origin HH:MM:SS; fixed grid 09:00:00 through 15:10:00.

endpoint_time.description: Same-date target endpoint HH:MM:SS, exactly origin plus ten minutes.

split.description: train, validation, or development_holdout; whole common dates, chronological.

no_cross_day_target.description: 1 iff origin/endpoint are on the same date; all rows are 1.

exact_ten_minute_target.description: 1 iff endpoint is exactly origin plus ten minutes; all rows are 1.

scheduled_session_regime.description: pre_20160801_extension or from_20160801_extension; documented schedule era, not a per-day session certification.

exceptional_session_status.description: Always unresolved; no inferred halt, holiday, auction, or exception-day flag.

origin_cache_row_exists.description: At origin: original cache contains this exact date/time row, before reindexing/filling.

origin_workbook_row_exists.description: At origin: supplied workbook contains this exact normalized date/time row.

origin_workbook_cache_status.description: At origin: full-row status matched_exact, matched_tolerance, conflict, cache_only, workbook_only, or absent_in_both; numeric tolerance atol=rtol=1e-12.

origin_cache_ask1_present.description: At origin: ask1 original cache cell is nonmissing before filling (infinity would be present but nonfinite).

origin_cache_ask1_finite.description: At origin: ask1 original cache cell is finite before filling.

origin_cache_ask1_finite_positive.description: At origin: ask1 original cache cell is finite and >0 before filling.

origin_cache_ask1_nonpositive.description: At origin: ask1 original cache cell is finite and <=0 before filling.

origin_ask1_fill_method.description: At origin: ask1 original (present), forward_fill (earlier same-day on-grid value), or zero_fill (no earlier present grid value). Zero-valued original cells stay original.

origin_ask1_source_time.description: At origin: ask1 supplying same-day grid time HH:MM:SS, or empty for zero_fill; origin fill source never exceeds origin.

origin_workbook_ask1_present.description: At origin: ask1 workbook cell nonmissing; not an exchange observation flag.

origin_cache_bid1_present.description: At origin: bid1 original cache cell is nonmissing before filling (infinity would be present but nonfinite).

origin_cache_bid1_finite.description: At origin: bid1 original cache cell is finite before filling.

origin_cache_bid1_finite_positive.description: At origin: bid1 original cache cell is finite and >0 before filling.

origin_cache_bid1_nonpositive.description: At origin: bid1 original cache cell is finite and <=0 before filling.

origin_bid1_fill_method.description: At origin: bid1 original (present), forward_fill (earlier same-day on-grid value), or zero_fill (no earlier present grid value). Zero-valued original cells stay original.

origin_bid1_source_time.description: At origin: bid1 supplying same-day grid time HH:MM:SS, or empty for zero_fill; origin fill source never exceeds origin.

origin_workbook_bid1_present.description: At origin: bid1 workbook cell nonmissing; not an exchange observation flag.

origin_crossed.description: At origin: both original cache quotes finite and bid1>ask1; nonpositive values are separately flagged.

origin_locked_positive.description: At origin: both original cache quotes finite and positive and bid1==ask1.

origin_valid_original_cache_quote.description: At origin: original bid1/ask1 finite, strictly positive, and not crossed; locked positive quotes allowed.

endpoint_cache_row_exists.description: At endpoint: original cache contains this exact date/time row, before reindexing/filling.

endpoint_workbook_row_exists.description: At endpoint: supplied workbook contains this exact normalized date/time row.

endpoint_workbook_cache_status.description: At endpoint: full-row status matched_exact, matched_tolerance, conflict, cache_only, workbook_only, or absent_in_both; numeric tolerance atol=rtol=1e-12.

endpoint_cache_ask1_present.description: At endpoint: ask1 original cache cell is nonmissing before filling (infinity would be present but nonfinite).

endpoint_cache_ask1_finite.description: At endpoint: ask1 original cache cell is finite before filling.

endpoint_cache_ask1_finite_positive.description: At endpoint: ask1 original cache cell is finite and >0 before filling.

endpoint_cache_ask1_nonpositive.description: At endpoint: ask1 original cache cell is finite and <=0 before filling.

endpoint_ask1_fill_method.description: At endpoint: ask1 original (present), forward_fill (earlier same-day on-grid value), or zero_fill (no earlier present grid value). Zero-valued original cells stay original.

endpoint_ask1_source_time.description: At endpoint: ask1 supplying same-day grid time HH:MM:SS, or empty for zero_fill; origin fill source never exceeds origin.

endpoint_workbook_ask1_present.description: At endpoint: ask1 workbook cell nonmissing; not an exchange observation flag.

endpoint_cache_bid1_present.description: At endpoint: bid1 original cache cell is nonmissing before filling (infinity would be present but nonfinite).

endpoint_cache_bid1_finite.description: At endpoint: bid1 original cache cell is finite before filling.

endpoint_cache_bid1_finite_positive.description: At endpoint: bid1 original cache cell is finite and >0 before filling.

endpoint_cache_bid1_nonpositive.description: At endpoint: bid1 original cache cell is finite and <=0 before filling.

endpoint_bid1_fill_method.description: At endpoint: bid1 original (present), forward_fill (earlier same-day on-grid value), or zero_fill (no earlier present grid value). Zero-valued original cells stay original.

endpoint_bid1_source_time.description: At endpoint: bid1 supplying same-day grid time HH:MM:SS, or empty for zero_fill; origin fill source never exceeds origin.

endpoint_workbook_bid1_present.description: At endpoint: bid1 workbook cell nonmissing; not an exchange observation flag.

endpoint_crossed.description: At endpoint: both original cache quotes finite and bid1>ask1; nonpositive values are separately flagged.

endpoint_locked_positive.description: At endpoint: both original cache quotes finite and positive and bid1==ask1.

endpoint_valid_original_cache_quote.description: At endpoint: original bid1/ask1 finite, strictly positive, and not crossed; locked positive quotes allowed.

origin_history_file_conflict.description: Any workbook/cache full-row conflict at an on-grid time up to and including origin in this asset-day; conservative provenance flag, not a quote-observation flag.

workbook_cache_filled_mid_equal_origin.description: Exact equality of float32 filled mids at origin under independent workbook/cache reconstructions.

workbook_cache_filled_mid_equal_endpoint.description: Exact equality of float32 filled mids at endpoint under independent workbook/cache reconstructions.

workbook_cache_label_match.description: Exact class agreement under independent workbook/cache float32 reconstructions.

missing_cache_quote_any_endpoint.description: Any missing (NaN/absent row) original bid1/ask1 at either endpoint; does not equate zero with missing.

historical_missing_cache_endpoint.description: Earlier audit definition: any absent/nonfinite original bid1/ask1 at either endpoint. Distinct from the positive, uncrossed P1 rule.

historical_missing_endpoint_kind.description: none, current, future, both according to historical_missing_cache_endpoint; disjoint categories.

equal_filled_mids.description: Exact equality of filled float32 current/future mids; NOT evidence of provider imputation.

historical_missing_equal_filled_flat.description: Historical missing endpoint AND equal filled mids AND legacy_label=1; overlapping subset of historical missing, not an independent exclusion.

candidate_clock.description: origin>=09:10:00 AND endpoint<=14:40:00, with the verified same-day ten-minute target; origins 09:10–14:30 inclusive.

P1_valid_cache_endpoints.description: Both original endpoints have finite positive bid1/ask1 and bid1<=ask1, with same-day ten-minute target. Positive locks retained. Ex-post evaluation eligibility.

P2_candidate_clock.description: P0 restricted only to candidate_clock; independent of quote validity.

P3_intersection.description: P1_valid_cache_endpoints AND P2_candidate_clock. Ex-post evaluation eligibility.

peer_origin_available_cache.description: Only origin_valid_original_cache_quote. Never uses a future endpoint or P1/P3; cache-based availability proxy, not provider release certification.

P1_exclusion_reasons.description: none or pipe-separated endpoint-qualified row_absent, ask1/bid1_missing, nonfinite, nonpositive, crossed; multiple reasons may overlap.

digest_serialization: UTF8 LF-terminated TAB-separated columns asset_id,date,origin_time[,endpoint_time,split,legacy_label], sorted lexicographically by asset_id,date,origin_time
